editorial:
You play a logger named Joe Braven who just wants a quiet weekend at his remote cabin with his family. But when a group of dangerous drug runners shows up looking for their hidden stash, that peaceful getaway turns into a brutal fight for survival. Jason Momoa carries the movie with his tough but warm presence, and the snowy, isolated setting gives everything a tense, grounded feel. It is the kind of simple, no-nonsense action story that does not try to be anything more than a solid thrill ride.

The action is gritty and physical, with plenty of hand-to-hand fights and clever use of the cabin and woods. The pacing stays tight, though the story is pretty predictable and the villains are fairly one-note. Still, if you enjoy straightforward survival thrillers with a strong lead, this is a fun pick. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final act, Joe uses his knowledge of the woods and cabin to pick off the drug runners one by one. His father, who has dementia, helps in a key moment before being injured. Joe eventually confronts the gang leader and kills him, saving his wife and daughter. The movie ends with the family safe and the cabin in ruins, showing that Joe's strength and love for his family carried him through.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves survival thrillers and Jason Momoa action movies.
